candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: Open to trout fishing all year — Boca Reservoir itself is not on CCR §7.50(b)'s special-regulations list, so the statewide default for lakes and reservoirs applies (no closed season). Note: the Little Truckee River reach immediately upstream, from Stampede Dam down to Boca Reservoir, is separately listed (7.50(b)(80), 0 trout / artificial lures barbless only) — that rule governs the river reach, not the reservoir.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: 5 trout per day, 10 in possession — the statewide default limit for California lakes and reservoirs (rainbow, brown, golden, and cutthroat trout combined).

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: 5 kokanee salmon per day, 10 in possession — Boca Reservoir is not among the reduced-limit exception waters (Bucks, Pardee, New Bullards Bar, Trinity), so the statewide landlocked-salmon default applies. CDFW records a kokanee plant at Boca (June 2026), confirming an active fishery. Counted separately from the trout limit.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: 5 black bass per day — statewide default for California lakes and reservoirs. Smallmouth bass presence at Boca Reservoir is reported by fishing-data sites but not directly confirmed via a CDFW stocking/survey page — treat species presence as medium confidence.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: 12-inch total-length minimum for black bass — statewide default for lakes and reservoirs.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: Anglers 16 and older must carry a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.requires_permit_note: A valid second-rod stamp is required to fish with a second rod.

candidates.summary: No bait or lure restrictions. Anglers may fish with up to 2 rods at once if they hold a valid second-rod stamp.

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document lists Boca Reservoir (Region 2, Nevada Co.) as receiving Sub-catchable Lahontan Cutthroat Trout under the Put and Grow program, release month range April-September. This is a provisional plan; CDFW's execution is not guaranteed.

CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document lists Boca Reservoir (Region 2, Nevada Co.) as receiving Fingerling Kokanee Salmon under the Put and Grow program, release month range April-June. This is a provisional plan; CDFW's execution is not guaranteed.
